quests.title: A mallet for the hand
quests.summary: A thought on waking. Gather wood and shape a mallet at the stump.

objectives.text: Craft a wooden mallet at the stump

quests.title: A mould for Hama
quests.summary: Overheard at the spoon stall. Hama-y Kawchkan needs a new spoon mould on his bench.

objectives.text: Craft a spoon mould at the carpenter's frame
Leave the mould on Hama's bench

quests.title: Two cups for the shelf
quests.summary: A paper on the mosque step. The tandoor clay wants two cups.

objectives.text: Shape two clay cups at the wheel
Set both cups by the tandoor

quests.title: A braid for the spring
quests.summary: Overheard by the water. The spring wants a four-strand braid.

objectives.text: Braid four strands of fibre at the stump
Hang the braid by the spring

quests.title: Three wandering runes
quests.summary: Overheard in the courtyard. Three rune stones have left the circle.

objectives.text: Touch the rune on the north ridge
Touch the rune on the east rock
Touch the rune on the south lane

quests.title: Worn things
quests.summary: A note by the lane. Take a worn rug apart at a workbench.

objectives.text: Take a worn rug apart at a workbench

quests.title: A short fence
quests.summary: A note by the pasture. Raise one wattle fence where the sheep drift.

objectives.text: Raise a wattle fence by the pasture

quests.title: A satchel for rubbings
quests.summary: Overheard at the hide racks. A satchel would keep a rune rubbing dry. Not required to leave the dream.

objectives.text: Craft a hide satchel at the stump

quests.title: The round loaf
quests.summary: Overheard at the oven. A boy says a round loaf should cost less. A coin on the cloth settles it.

objectives.text: Pay a village coin for the loaf at the trade cloth

quests.title: The borrowed jug
quests.summary: Overheard by the spring. An aunt will lend the jug if a coin waits for its return.

objectives.text: Leave a village coin so the jug can be lent

quests.title: One jar at dawn
quests.summary: Overheard near the stump. An elder will hire a boy for one dawn jar. The boy has already counted the steps.

objectives.text: Hire the boy with a village coin at the trade cloth
